title: I just reached 332 wishlists !!
author: COCOASOO
selftext:
After a few months with the Steam page uploaded and less than 2 months to launch my first game, im about to reach 333 wishlists.

At first i didn't expect really much of my game, maybe reach 50 wishlists. But now after a few contect creators covered the game i decided to update the game and add a lot of content into it.

My goal its prepare the October Next fest and try to gain a bit more wishlists there. I do know that to get more exposure i at least need a few thousand wishlist but i dont really expect to achieve that.

Any thoughts of what should i do next?
